messages.content: 今天的板球比賽中有誰？

function.name: sports_analyzer_get_schedule
function.description: Retrieve the schedule of cricket matches for a specific date. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

date.description: The date for which to get the schedule of matches.

sport.description: The type of sport. Default is cricket.

country.description: The country for which to get the schedule. If not provided, all countries will be included. Default: 'USA'

message.reasoning:
The user asks in Chinese: "今天的板球比賽中有誰？" meaning "Who is playing in today's cricket matches?" We need to retrieve schedule for today. Use function sports_analyzer_get_schedule with date= today's date. Need to provide date string. Probably format like YYYY-MM-DD. Today is 2026-07-08. So call function with date="2026-07-08", sport="cricket". Country unspecified so default USA? But we want all countries. The function signature says country optional default 'USA', but if omitted it defaults to USA. To include all countries, maybe pass empty or omit? It says default: 'USA' if not provided. That means if we don't provide country, it will default to USA. But we want all countries. Maybe we can set country=""? Not sure. The description: "If not provided, all countries will be included. Default: 'USA'" contradictory. Might be mis-specified. Let's assume we can omit country to get all. We'll just omit.

So call function.
